# Mane Man API: the client app

mm-api on the client app's host (docs/decisions/0026-hosts-and-surfaces.md), served at https://{host}/api/*. Every route but /api/health and /api/auth/* needs the mm_app session cookie, and every write needs the page's own Origin. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

Errors carry a stable code and the request ID, never a stack trace or provider message:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "request_id": "…"
  }
}
```

**200**: Healthy

```json
{

}
```

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Health"
```

### POST /api/auth/otp

Send a login code on WhatsApp. The answer is the same whether or not the number has a booking

Request body:

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginRequest"
}
```

**202**: A code is on its way, if this number has a booking

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginChallenge"
}
```

**400**: invalid_request

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**429**: rate_limited: too many codes for this number today, or from this address this hour

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**503**: busy: today's ceiling on codes is reached

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

### POST /api/auth/otp/resend

Send a fresh code on WhatsApp, 30 seconds after the last one

Request body:

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginChallengeRequest"
}
```

**202**: A code is on its way, if this number has a booking

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginChallenge"
}
```

**410**: code_expired: start again

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**429**: too_early, or rate_limited

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**503**: busy

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

### POST /api/auth/verify

Check a code. The right one opens a session (the mm_app cookie)

Request body:

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginVerifyRequest"
}
```

**200**: Right, with a session; or wrong, with the attempts left

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginVerify"
}
```

**400**: invalid_request

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**410**: code_expired: expired, used, or void after five wrong codes

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

### POST /api/auth/logout

End this session

**204**: Logged out

```json
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

### Health

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ok",
        "unavailable"
      ]
    },

      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "local",
        "staging",
        "production"
      ]
    },
    "version_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Cloudflare Worker version ID serving this request."
    },
    "version_tag": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Tag given at upload: the git commit SHA in remote environments."
    },
    "d1": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ok",
        "unmarked",
        "mismatch",
        "unreachable"
      ],
      "description": "ok: reachable and marked as this environment's database. unmarked: no identity row. mismatch: marked as another environment's database."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "status",
    "environment",
    "version_id",
    "version_tag",
    "d1"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
